title: 贾克斯·灯下小点心
description: 紫色兜帽贾克斯坐在灯柱旁，双手剥一个煮蛋，标志多孔面罩与长柄路灯保持可辨。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Jax is a broad mysterious humanoid fighter covered by a purple hooded coat, layered robes, gloves, boots, and a metal face mask with several small round glowing eye apertures. Preserve the concealed face and distinctive clustered lights without inventing a visible human identity. His long lamp-post staff stands upright in a secure holder, its lantern glowing softly and remaining entirely inactive.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a low roadside bench and gently peels a boiled egg over a small wooden plate. His gloved fingers and patient tilted head make the simple snack expressive despite the mask. A folded cloth and a quiet rounded wall form the background, and the familiar lamp-post stays still beside him as a warm light source.
art_direction.palette: plum purple, warm brass, egg cream, amber glow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
